comment: Pinned published baseline for BoopaDB population/UI/evidence gates. Proposed checked-in location: generator/baseline_pin.json. Values are FIXED reference values from the verified published baseline; update only by a reviewed change, never from live reads.

thumbnail_correction_2625416.applies_when: image missing only; the guard is preserved and the confirmation time must not be rewritten to a newer time

generation_source: Producer handoff pointer sequence: run 20261031T022523-97de08e237b544de9d2a07cb788cc2da advanced the pointer from sequence 0 to 1 (receipt Drive file 1LsRxYocjZNyGevVZXEZumq4T8OtUGVml). The published baseline is that run's 2026-10-31 candidate (201,872 items) with dot's UI candidate applied. Candidate generations in the Actions route must be strictly greater than the live generation; this pin supplies the generation for the known published baseline only.

relations_binding.source: producer-install/config/producer-config.json build_inputs (the producer config itself is SHA-pinned: 68e27928ea5971a7be0f839db021f8fa90cd77ff330b61842ccf9914e236b9f9). The candidate build records the SHA256 of the actual bundle manifests and approval files it consumed in its run manifest; validate asserts equality with this pinned set.

sentinel_definition: baseline_prev_release_sentinel is the SHA256 of the published baseline's snapshot-manifest.json FILE BYTES (verified locally: sha256sum of the 2026-10-31 candidate's snapshot-manifest.json = 39075ec4...; its validation block reads rows=201872, max_date=2026-10-31). The baseline was published by the old route and carries NO release-manifest.json, so the snapshot-manifest — the fixed manifest of that publication — is the lineage anchor for the FIRST promotion: a first-promotion candidate must declare prev_release_digest == this sentinel, generation == pin generation + 1, and the live index.html/item.html must hash (git hash-object) to the pinned blobs with live snapshot rows/max_date equal to the pin. Any other no-release-manifest live state fails.
